name: The Seats of the Players
aspect: Why two islands hang over the Aravali strait, and who is said to have sat on them
notes:
The islands over the Aravali strait are held to be the seats Varuna and Indra took when they sat to play the chess of fate at the behest of Dyaus Pitar -- so the strait is not a place the game was played *near*, it is the table.

They were sunken lands first. The telling is that as humans appeared the prana vayu rose, and the drowned country rose with it into the sky, which is why the rain on their undersides falls upward and why there is country up there at all.

**This does not compete with the lodestone.** `poi_lodestone_face` has the ore holding the island up, and that is the present mechanism rather than the origin; the breath lifted the land and the ore is what keeps it lifted. Anyone reconciling the two should reconcile them that way rather than deleting one.

**And nobody on the map will tell a player any of this.** `field_map_aravali`'s own arrival line has the islands 'holding themselves up out of nothing anybody here will explain', which stays exactly true: this is what canon knows, not what the rail-head knows. The Jharwa performed rituals up there before the migrations, and the people who came after them built `poi_stacked_temple` on the same ground -- so the seats have been treated as holy by two peoples in succession, one of which destroyed the other.
